attr.title: Just Ignore Them
attr.desc: Just Ignore Them is a point and click horror adventure about Mark, whose life has been haunted by monsters since childhood. Are the monsters real, or is there something else going on?
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the gamedata folder.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/561770/Just_Ignore_Them/) and copy all game files into the gamedata folder.
